run_newton_cg: run the _newton_cg function to minimize a scalar function using Newton conjugate gradient optimization
run_line_search_wolfe12: run the _line_search_wolfe12 function to find a suitable step size with Wolfe condition fallback
run_cg_solver: run the _cg function to solve a linear system iteratively using conjugate gradient descent
check_optimize_result: check the _check_optimize_result function to validate convergence of an lbfgs optimizer result
review_line_search_error: review the _LineSearchError exception class used when line search fails to find a suitable step size
